content: Better Auth (npm latest 1.7.2): self-hosted TS auth library, own Postgres via Drizzle/Prisma adapter, no per-MAU billing, plugin-based MFA/passkeys. Clerk: hosted UI, fast to ship, free to 50k MRU then $0.02/MRU. Supabase Auth: good only if already on Supabase, RLS via auth.uid(). NextAuth/Auth.js: legacy, migrate to Better Auth for greenfield.
